entities.summary: Edward Hiiboro Kussala is a South Sudanese prelate of the Catholic Church who is the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Tombura-Yambio, in South Sudan since 19 April 2008. Before then, from 20 May 1994 until he was appointed bishop, he was a priest of the same Catholic diocese. He was appointed bishop by Pope Benedict XVI. He was consecrated bishop on 29 June 2008.
